title: Zinus Florence Bed Base 90 x 190 cm with Metal Slats – Sturdy Metal Frame and Headboard – Height 35 cm for Storage – Easy Assembly – Black
description: Description du produit The Florence metal bed frame combines vintage elegance with functionality. Its black finish and classic design headboard/footboard add a timeless touch. With 35 cm of clearance under the bed, you have convenient storage. Constructed of durable steel with metal slats, Florence offers a solid base while remaining lightweight for easy assembly and moving. Hassle-free assembly (all included). 5 year warranty. The Florence adult bed frames impress with their retro charm and robustness. Avertissement De Sûreté Note: During assembly, small parts or tools can be used, please keep them carefully. Note: This bed frame may make noise during use, please keep it in good condition to avoid disturbance.
feature_bullets: ELEGANT VINTAGE STYLE: This black metal bed frame with decorated headboard and footboard brings sophistication and retro charm, fitting perfectly into any bedroom style while remaining timeless
OPTIMAL STORAGE SPACE: At 35 cm in height under the slatted base, you have ample space to store suitcases, boxes or linens and keep your room organised without compromising on style
DURABLE ROBUSTY: Constructed of high quality steel, this bed base ensures stability and exceptional support for any type of mattress, ensuring comfort and reliability for many years of sleep
EASY ASSEMBLY: All tools, parts and instructions are efficiently packed in one box for hassle-free assembly of your single or double bed in less than an hour to two
Guaranteed serenity: Sleep on both ears with a 5-year limited warranty included, for quality and durability; Mattress sold separately

product_details.Other Special Features of the Product: All tools included, Durable structure, Easy assembly, No Box Spring Needed, Squeak Resistant
product_details.Included Components: Assembly tools, Headboard, Installation Manual, Slat
product_details.Assembly Instructions Description: Assembly instructions are supplied in French and are easy to follow.
